name: Windows Terminal
summary: Microsoft's tabbed GPU-rendered terminal for Windows 10/11. JSON (JSONC) settings with per-profile background images, acrylic/Mica, an experimental HLSL pixel-shader hook, quake mode and Sixel images.

install.notes: Stable. Preview channel: Microsoft.WindowsTerminal.Preview. Also in the Microsoft Store.

windows.notes: settings.json is JSONC (comments and trailing commas allowed) and the Settings UI rewrites the file: always merge into the existing JSON, never overwrite it. Packaged stable path: {localappdata}/Packages/Microsoft.WindowsTerminal_8wekyb3d8bbwe/LocalState/settings.json. Preview: {localappdata}/Packages/Microsoft.WindowsTerminalPreview_8wekyb3d8bbwe/LocalState/settings.json. Unpackaged (Scoop, Chocolatey, GitHub zip): {localappdata}/Microsoft/Windows Terminal/settings.json. %USERPROFILE% is expanded inside backgroundImage, experimental.pixelShaderPath and icon. Windows Terminal has no CLI config validator and wt --version is not a reliable detector, so detect reads the Appx package version and validation means parsing the JSONC and checking keys against the schema (https://aka.ms/terminal-profiles-schema). Saved changes reload live in open windows. Some documented features are marked Preview-only in the docs (window frame colors, enableUnfocusedAcrylic, allowHeadless); check them against the installed channel.

font-fallback.notes: A comma-separated face list works; the docs describe face as a single name, so this relies on the verified Eclipse preset behaviour.

blur.notes: Acrylic per profile, Mica via a theme (Windows 11 build 22621+).

background-image.notes: Images are cached by path: a regenerated image needs a new file name.

background-animated.notes: backgroundImage accepts .gif but animated playback is not confirmed by the docs; a time-driven pixel shader (Time constant) is the reliable route.

shader.notes: Experimental: experimental.pixelShaderPath (HLSL). Continued existence is not guaranteed by Microsoft.

inline-images.notes: Sixel only; no iTerm2 or Kitty image protocols.
